summary: A completed empty projection no longer changes the reconciler's observation token; unchanged owned-set rows are not rewritten

replay.detail: No replay or backfill is added; nonempty and zero-count replay attempts retain conservative invalidation.

schema.detail: No table, index, claim kind, replication digest or version changes. A private process-lifetime deferral nonce guards token restoration.

rules.detail: Owned-set selection, lineage, conflicts, pending references and fresh effect authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Wire fields and getter shape are unchanged. Runtimes opt in only when empty projection hooks have exclusively row effects; unknown runtimes remain conservative. Non-opted runtimes retain their existing semantics.

downtime.detail: Intended idle-CPU correction for unnecessary reevaluation after empty projection attempts; production cause and saving are not proved by source. Normal rolling deployment; no startup conversion.

recovery.detail: Errors, pending work, replay, real writes and a newer deferral prevent restoration. Feed error/gap invalidation and partial projection recovery remain unchanged; a saturated nonce or wrapping entry stays conservative.
